analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 판정 유지. RSI 63.3으로 과매수 구간에서 냉각 중이며, MACD 히스토그램은 3.5144로 개선세를 보이나 5일 전 12.6032 대비 강도가 약화. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.28로 위축된 거래량은 현재 움직임의 신뢰도를 낮춤. 스윙 지지선 $2,626.87, 저항선 $2,720.27 사이 횡보 구간 진입.
analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance is maintained for the third consecutive trading day. RSI at 63.3 is cooling from overbought territory, and while the MACD histogram is improving to 3.5144, its strength has weakened from 12.6032 five days ago. The volume ratio of 0.28 compared to the 5-day average indicates subdued trading activity, lowering the conviction of current price movements. The price is consolidating between the swing support at $2,626.87 and resistance at $2,720.27.
